description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Rendclaw Trow.
When Rendclaw Trow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Rendclaw Trow.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
